notes.title: Bonanit is closer than ever!
notes.notes:
[p]I know I've been quiet around here for a while... but I haven't been idle. As you already know, Bonanit is a solo project, and that means everything moves a bit slower "but with a lot of love and dedication". [/p][h3][b]Today, I can finally share something that makes me incredibly excited: The release date is now very, VERY close.[/b][/h3][p]First of all, I want to say THANK YOU to all the content creators who dared to try the demo. It was a very early version (maybe too early), but even so, you jumped in and gave me a lot of feedback. [b]I've read all your comments and applied a ton of improvements[/b] to make the final game more solid, more immersive… and much more terrifying.[/p][p]For those who haven't heard about it yet: Bonanit is a psychological horror game where you're trapped in your bed, a victim of sleep paralysis, while something moves in the darkness of your room on a stormy night. Each run is 100% random, [b]no night is the same[/b], and every blink could be your last. Will you survive until dawn?
[/p][h2][b]More than 1000 people have added Bonanit to their wishlist on Steam.
[/b][/h2][p]Honestly, I didn't expect it. I'm just one person behind all of this, so seeing such support is simply incredible. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. If you haven't yet, I encourage you to add Bonanit to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.[/p][h3][b]Thank you for being there![/b][/h3]

notes.title: The First Bonanit Demo is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]The moment you've been waiting for is here![/h1] 

You can now download and play the first playable demo of Bonanit on Steam. Get comfortable (if you dare), turn off the lights, and prepare to experience one of the most terrifying games we've created so far.

In Bonanit, you're trapped in your own bed, helpless against the horrors lurking in every corner of your room. Every blink counts, and every object might be changing. The best part? Every playthrough is different, so no two scares are ever the same!

[h2]Why should you try it?[/h2] 

Because we want you to experience the fear firsthand before the full game releases. The demo lets you feel the tension, discover the unique mechanics, and share your feedback with us so we can keep improving. Your experience is crucial in helping us perfect every last detail.

Are you brave enough? Download the demo now and put your courage to the test! If you survive this nightmare, don't forget to add Bonanit to your wishlist and get ready for the full release.

This is just a small taste of the horror to come... Don't miss out!

notes.title: Perfecting Every Detail
notes.notes:
[h2]We are excited to share that we are in the final stages of developing our game, and we haven't left any stone unturned to ensure that the experience is as immersive as possible.[/h2] 
We take pride in polishing every little detail, no matter how imperceptible it may seem, to offer you an adventure that truly draws you into our world.

One of the adjustments we recently made was fixing a small issue with the flickering lights. Although it might have gone unnoticed by most, we realized that after a flicker, the lights retained the "on" material in their static mesh, even when they were off. As the perfectionists we are, we couldn't ignore this detail. We know that these small elements can make all the difference in the player's experience, and we made sure everything works perfectly.

[h2]Additionally, we've added more random anomalies to keep the tension high and the experience fresh in every playthrough.[/h2] 
Our goal is for every player to feel like they're living a unique and thrilling experience every time they play.

We are committed to continually improving and refining the game so that when it's time for you to play, you'll be met with a truly incredible experience.

Thank you for your patience and support! We are eager for you to enjoy it as much as we have enjoyed creating it.
